name: OpenConfig gNMI Gateway
description: Modular, distributed, and highly available service for connecting to multiple gNMI targets for network telemetry. Supports clustering via Zookeeper with Prometheus and Kafka exporters.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Examples showing Docker network bridges, gnmi-gateway and Prometheus containers on shared network.

eval_notes: Distributed gNMI gateway for scaling telemetry collection. Useful for evaluations involving high-availability telemetry architectures. Marked as experimental pre-release. Less active development since 2021. Designed for collecting and distributing gNMI telemetry at scale. Prometheus integration example included. Not a NOS itself but essential gNMI infrastructure.
